sources.title: Mistral - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The Mistral team has released 3 checkpoints: a base model, Mistral-7B-v0.1, which has been pre-trained to predict the next token on internet-scale data. an instruction tuned model, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.1, which is the base model optimized for chat purposes using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and direct preference optimization (DPO).
